feedback: The query aggregates all missed races for a driver-year into a single record, so it does not correctly identify distinct contiguous missed‑race sequences as required by the Action Plan.

If a driver has multiple separate missed blocks within the same year, the query treats them as one block (using MIN and MAX), which violates the step of recording the first and last missed round for each qualifying sequence.
The driver_years CTE only includes drivers who have at least one result entry in a year; drivers who missed every race in a year are excluded, which may contradict the intended coverage.
The logic assumes the missed races form a single contiguous block; it does not enforce contiguity of the missed rounds before calculating first_missed and last_missed.
